title: Pre-registered commit-step rule search (offline replay), 2026-11-02
data: pro6000 stock jsonl per (model, dataset) cell, 4 models x 7 datasets = 28 cells; per-item answer-slot write history pos0_argmax and commit-step letter logits
replay_note: Rules change only the token committed into the answer slot; earlier steps and unmask order equal stock. Exact for models whose letter is the leading token (validated 6/6 vs real hyst decodes). For LLaDA-V the letter commits early and later text is regenerated, so LLaDA-V replay is approximate.
labels_default: if a record has no labels field: A..(n_opt) for MCQ datasets; Yes/No for pope and mme

answer_parser.applies_to: all cells (stock and replayed outputs); defined before looking at accuracy
mcq: 1. if finished_letter (leading token) is a valid option letter, use it
2. first match of (?i:answer)\s*(?i:is|:)?\s*\(?([A-E])\b  (letter must be uppercase)
letter must be among the first n_opt letters; otherwise unparsed (counted wrong)
yes_no: 1. if finished_letter is yes/no, use it
2. else first whole-word yes|no (case-insensitive) in finished_text
answer_parser.not_used: option-text matching (records carry no option texts)

R0_stock.desc: commit the model's own last write

R1_vote_all.desc: majority of valid-option letters over the slot's whole write history; ties to the latest

R2_back1.desc: commit the write one step before the unmask step

R3_run.desc: if the final letter held fewer than K steps, restore the previous different letter

R4_early_m.desc: if commit top-2 option margin < tau, use the first-half majority

R5_commit_spread.desc: argmax of commit logits minus alpha_n log p_cf, alpha_n = 1 - p_min/p_max; stock where no commit logits or no prior

R6_agree_gate.desc: phenomenon-derived: keep the last write if it equals the history majority; otherwise commit the argmax of (commit logits - alpha_n log p_cf) among letters the slot actually wrote

selection_criterion: maximize pooled net change in correct answers summed over all cells on the dev split; ties broken toward fewer constants, then toward the order R0,R1,R2,R5,R6,R3,R4. Stock may win.
split: per cell, items shuffled with random.Random('20261102:' + cell) and split 50/50 into dev (first half) and held-out (second half). Held-out never used for selection.
cross_cell: models: select on {lavida, mmada} (all items), test on {dreamvl, lladav}; and the reverse
datasets: select on {sciqa, m3cot, mmbench, mmstar}, test on {pope, mme, vstar}; and the reverse
reporting: per-cell held-out delta (correct count), wins/losses/ties, net; paired bootstrap 95% CI of pooled held-out delta (items resampled within cell, 2000 reps, seed 20261102), for all cells, excluding yes/no datasets (pope, mme), and excluding LLaDA-V; oracle upper bound per cell (gold appears anywhere in the write history) labelled as oracle
